h: Mr Macaroni earns master's degree with distinction from UK drama school
p: Comedian and actor Mr Macaroni has reportedly graduated with a Master of Arts with Distinction in Performance (Acting) from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts in London. He shared a video from his convocation with family.
body: Comedian and actor Debo Adedayo, popularly known as Mr Macaroni, has added a new academic achievement to his name.

In a video shared on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the entertainer celebrated graduating with a Master of Arts with Distinction in Performance (Acting) from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts, a leading drama school in London. The clip showed him at the convocation ceremony surrounded by family members and well-wishers.
Mr Macaroni previously studied Theatre Arts and Film Studies at Redeemer's University, where he also did postgraduate work in performance, and studied at other institutions in Nigeria.

Mr Macaroni became one of Nigeria's most popular skit makers with his character, a wealthy and eccentric older man, and has also acted in films and television. He is known for speaking out on social issues and took part in the 2020 EndSARS protests against police brutality. He has also been a vocal commentator on governance and the economy.
Fans and colleagues flooded his page with congratulations, praising him for combining comedy with serious study, and saying his achievement was an inspiration to young creatives.
more: He earned an MA with Distinction in Performance (Acting).
The degree is from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts in London.
Fans praised his commitment to education.
